Updated [frontier-21-batch-7.pages.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-21-batch-7.pages.json), added [frontier-21-batch-7.coverage.json](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-21-batch-7.coverage.json), and added [frontier-21-batch-7.notes.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/frontier-21-batch-7.notes.md). The scaffold now carries 6 A-page items and 5 B-page items, avoids re-minting already-published MT-4 / real-analysis comparison results, and reuses the published dense-open-small-measure witness for the monotone-limit example.

Validation on Thursday, August 27, 2026: `coverage-checklist` passed (`1` page, `24` harvested results), manifest-only `content-policy` passed, and `validate-plan` exited `0` with only the repository’s existing `redundant-prereq` advisories. The shell source checks did not pass: `source-fetch-check --stamp` and `url-sweep` both failed at local DNS resolution for the two recorded sources, so no `fetch_verified` stamps were written. I recorded the exact failures and rerun commands in the notes, and I did verify the source texts at the recorded locators in the web-reading channel: [Bass PDF](https://draft-r-bass-scholar.media.uconn.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/3926/2024/12/real-analysis-for-graduate-students_version-50_accessible.pdf) and [Wheeden-Zygmund](https://djvu.online/file/u1gYJemR8hzMe).

One deliberate open point is also recorded in the notes: I did not add a separate local MT-9 item for the false upgrade “Riemann integrable implies Borel,” because the clean witness wants a stronger non-Borel null-set location than the current published abstract item states.
